The main attribution is the creation and execution of system, functional and non-functional tests for the products and solutions offered by Rohde & Schwarz Critical Infrastructure & Networks division, with a strong focus on test automation. Test activities must be performed within the allocated budget and agreed time frame, continuously increasing product quality and meeting end-customer expectations. The job involves activities in a global team, working independently on various software/hardware development projects and collaborating closely with technical stakeholders.
Your tasks
Take ownership of the quality of assigned features, components or product areas.
Handle day-to-day quality issues for the owned area and escalate risks when needed.
Collaborate with R&D, System Engineering and Support teams to identify technical solutions that suit business and product needs.
Develop and maintain relevant user scenarios, test cases, checklists and regression test coverage.
Manually execute functional and non-functional tests when needed, ensuring reliable test evidence and traceability.
Implement, maintain and extend automated test cases wherever suitable and efficient.
Contribute to best practices for test automation, test execution and test management.
Report, track and follow up defects, working closely with developers to resolve and verify issues.
Design, deploy and maintain internal infrastructure and test environments needed for testing activities.
Improve existing test automation processes, scripts and frameworks.
Create and maintain test documentation, reports and status updates for stakeholders.
Analyze real-world customer issues, support root-cause analysis and contribute to sustainable corrective actions.
Mentor junior colleagues on testing practices, product behavior and automation topics when needed.
 Your Qualifications
University degree in Electronics, Computer Science or similar education.
2-5 years of experience in testing software products or technical solutions, including Linux operating systems and applications, scripting and system / application log collection.
Solid understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, tools and processes.
Experience with test automation frameworks; Behavior Driven Development experience is an advantage.
Good Selenium WebDriver knowledge.
Good experience in programming / scripting languages, preferably Python and Bash scripting.
Good knowledge of version control systems, preferably Git or SVN.
Experience using virtualization platforms such as VMware, OpenStack or Proxmox; administration experience is an advantage.
Experience using CI/CD tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins or GitLab.
Telecommunication knowledge and understanding of VoIP related protocols is an advantage.
Good understanding of SQL queries and database concepts.
Experience managing tests and issues in Jira, TestLink, Redmine or similar tools.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written.
Proactive working style with the ability to adapt to change.
Analytical and problem-solving skills with a can-do attitude.
Very good English skills.
Strong teamwork abilities.
 Interested?
We are looking forward to receiving your application! Ideally, you should apply online with the reference number. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact your recruiting contact via LinkedIn.
